templates.description:
将动漫/插画角色转换为超写实真人，首帧严格来自动漫图，服装/场景/发色/姿势完全保留，仅风格真人化+脸部替换为描述的真人特征。

【使用方法 — 必须配合 v1.5 工作流】
1. 加载 v1.5 工作流（不是v1.4！v1.5已断开last_frame避免转场）
2. 模式选择「图生视频 (Image to Video)」
3. 图1上传动漫图（作为首帧，提供服装/场景/姿势/发色）
4. 图2上传真人图（仅用于参考，v1.5已断开图2到模型的连接）
5. 在提示词的 FACIAL REFERENCE 区域，把 [在此详细填写...] 替换为真人图的脸部特征描述（越详细越好）
6. 运行

【为什么不用双图参考生视频】
ReferenceToVideo 模式本质是两张图之间的转场融合，会导致最终变成真人图的服装/场景/发型（已验证失败）。I2V首帧模式只有动漫图作为起点，从根本上避免转场问题。

【为什么脸部用文字描述而不是图片】
I2V模式只接受一张首帧图。真人图不连接模型，仅作为用户参考，脸部特征通过文字描述注入。这样模型不会被真人图的服装/场景干扰。
templates.description_en:
Convert an anime or illustration character into a hyperreal real person: the first frame comes strictly from the anime image, keeping the outfit, scene, hair colour and pose exactly, with only the style made photorealistic and the face replaced by the described real features. 

[HOW TO USE - must be used with the v1.5 workflow] 
1. Load the v1.5 workflow (not v1.4: v1.5 disconnects last_frame to avoid a transition) 
2. Set the mode to Image to Video 
3. Upload the anime image as Img1 (the first frame, supplying outfit, scene, pose and hair colour) 
4. Upload the real-person image as Img2 (reference only; v1.5 has already disconnected Img2 from the model) 
5. In the FACIAL REFERENCE section of the prompt, replace [describe here in detail...] with a description of the face in the real photo (the more detail the better) 
6. Run 

[WHY NOT TWO-IMAGE REFERENCE TO VIDEO] 
Reference to Video is essentially a transition between two images, so the result ends up wearing the real photo's outfit, scene and hairstyle (verified to fail). The I2V first-frame mode uses only the anime image as the starting point, which structurally avoids that problem. 

[WHY DESCRIBE THE FACE IN WORDS INSTEAD OF AN IMAGE] 
I2V accepts only one first-frame image. The real photo is not connected to the model and serves only as a reference for you, with the facial features injected through the text description, so the model is never disturbed by that photo's outfit or scene.
